decisions.decision: One serial Sonnet worker for all of groups 1-3; no parallel split.
decisions.why: tasks.md header already states groups 1 and 2 touch the same file (internal/tesla/types.go), so a parallel split would contend on one file. Sonnet is the SKILL Step 5.2 default: this is normal implementation plus tests plus a doc edit, not a trivial single-line mechanical change (Haiku) and not cross-cutting or ambiguous (Opus).

decisions.decision: Group 4 (4.1-4.4) is run by the leader, not the worker.
decisions.why: It is the verification gate, and 4.3 (`go build ./...`) reaches outside the worker's internal/tesla sandbox. CLAUDE.md authorises the assistant to run build/vet/test in THIS project.

decisions.decision: Dropped `docs/layer2-user-vehicle-access.md` from the dispatch pack and substituted the real path `docs/0-set-up/layer2-user-vehicle-access.md`.
decisions.why: internal/tesla/AGENTS.md (and the root CLAUDE.md) declare a path that no longer exists - the file moved under docs/0-set-up/. SKILL Step 0.5 says drop a missing declared path and note it rather than failing the dispatch. The stale references are real doc rot but belong to neither this tier nor the worker's sandbox; reported to the user instead.

decisions.decision: Leader rewrote TestTpmsPressurePSICompanions' expectations from `2.9*barToPSI` to the literals 42.0609439417 / 40.6105665644 / 39.1601891871 / 37.7098118098.
decisions.why: Step 5.6 cross-check: the worker asserted against the same constant the method multiplies by, so the test pinned the field wiring but NOT the factor - it would pass even if barToPSI were wrong. tasks.md 2.1 says 'multiplied by 14.503773773', and the gold-standard TestMetricCompanions spells out 80.4672 rather than 50*milesToKm. Test strengthened, no criterion altered.
